name: pagination
description: A named navigation landmark with page numbers and previous and next buttons. The current page is at least one and at most the page count. A button requests a page with a mu-page-change event. Page code supplies the new content and current page.

parts.name: details
parts.description: Control and technical details of a refusal.

parts.name: gap
parts.description: Visual mark for page numbers that do not show.

parts.name: next-page
parts.description: Button that requests the next page.

parts.name: page
parts.description: Page number button. The current page has a visible mark.

parts.name: previous-page
parts.description: Button that requests the previous page.
